Mission Local reported that the Mission Economic Development Agency (MEDA) was purchasing a four-story brick building at 2901 16th St., two blocks east of the 16th Street BART station, and planned to convert it into 62 units of permanent affordable housing. The purchase was subject to city approval of a loan.
